run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to compute the sum of absolute differences between row and column indices in an n by n matrix
test_f_filled: test the f_filled implementation against f_gold using the built-in parameter sets in the main block
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it builds an n by n matrix of absolute row column index differences
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to compute the sum of absolute row column index differences without building the full matrix
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which creates an n by n matrix where each element is abs(i minus j) and returns the total sum
